visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with glasses and black hair sits on a brown leather sofa, holding a newspaper titled 'TAIPEI TIMES' with a serious expression. A woman with long dark hair and a pink shirt, wearing a blue medical mask, sits at a desk with a computer monitor, turning her head slightly to address him. (2) The camera shifts to a close-up of the man as he looks directly into the lens, speaking with a slight smirk; he is wearing a blue denim-like button-up shirt over a white undershirt. (3) A series of fast cuts show the man working intensely on a silver laptop on a light wood coffee table, holding a glass beaker containing clear liquid, and then appearing in a full-body blue plush mouse costume with a number '2' on the chest, giving a thumbs-up. (4) In a blue-tinted room, the man in the mouse costume (now with '1') yawns widely while holding a script; meanwhile, the man in goggles and a blue shirt marks a white clipboard with a pen. (5) The man in the '2' mouse costume reads a paper, and the man in goggles holds up a page where the large red Chinese characters '難笑!' (not funny) are written with a red marker. (6) The man in a '3' mouse costume laughs hysterically while holding papers; the goggled man smiles broadly and writes vigorously on his clipboard in a bright, blue-lit environment. (7) The man stands in a room with white curtains, pointing to his waist while wearing black pants with white stitching; he demonstrates flexibility by wiggling his hips. (8) A fast-paced montage shows the man bowing deeply multiple times while holding a smartphone to his ear, appearing submissive and energetic. (9) The man sits at a table displaying four distinct boxes of UCC coffee (maroon, blue, orange, red); he holds up individual coffee packets while looking into the camera with a professional, endorsing smile. (10) The UCC brand logo appears over a blurred background of the coffee boxes; the man is then seen back on the phone next to a stack of boxes and an open laptop. (11) Close-up shots feature the man tearing open packets and smelling the aroma, followed by high-definition b-roll of hot water being poured through a drip coffee filter into a clear glass cup. (12) The man is shown tasting the coffee from a clear glass cup, looking satisfied; he then holds up all four boxes in front of his face as the woman from the first scene gestures from her desk.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Comedic Demonstration -> Product Transition -> Detailed Feature Showcase -> Meta-Humor Outro
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video uses self-deprecating comedy to address audience perceptions of 'sponsored content' while explicitly promoting UCC drip coffee. It portrays the 'hard work' of a creator through absurd scenarios like testing scripts on 'rats' and showing professional submissiveness to clients, before pivoting into a high-quality product endorsement that highlights specific flavor profiles.
